7
Two boys of equal weight sit on one side of a see-saw, as shown. Their father, of weight 1000N,
sits on the other side. The see-saw is balanced and is being used so that it moves up and down.
During one part of the cycle, the father descends through a distance of 40cm. At the same time,
the boy nearest the pivot rises through 20cm, while the other boy rises through 80cm.
What is the weight of each boy?
A
200N
B
400N
C
600N
D
800N
subject: Physics
